## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) — unhealthy in all regions with an 18% error rate.

**Action taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Reviewed current status and deployment history:
   - v2.2.9 — healthy (production)
   - v2.3.0 — healthy (production) ← most recent healthy release
   - v2.3.1 — unhealthy (production, current)

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is back on v2.3.0, **healthy** in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Note:** The unhealthy v2.3.1 release should be investigated before any future redeploy, and the staging candidate v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy — worth reviewing the release pipeline.
